root_cause.text: A race condition in f2fs_write_end_io where f2fs_in_warm_node_list() accesses sbi->node_inode after it may have been freed and set to NULL by the umount path, because dec_page_count() can wake up the umount thread, which then destroys the node inode before the subsequent node list check.
root_cause.evidence: The patch moves the f2fs_in_warm_node_list() call before dec_page_count() to prevent the use-after-free. The CVE description details the race: "dec_page_count(sbi, F2FS_WB_CP_DATA) ... wake_up(&sbi->cp_wait)" allowing umount to iput(sbi->node_inode) and set it to NULL, followed by "f2fs_in_warm_node_list ... is_node_folio // sbi->node_inode is NULL and panic".

intent_record.intent_summary: Remove fsync node entry after writeback for warm node pages to avoid stale entries.
intent_record.what: In 'f2fs_write_end_io', after handling node pages, added a check 'if (f2fs_in_warm_node_list(sbi, folio))' and a call to 'f2fs_del_fsync_node_entry(sbi, folio)'.
intent_record.how: After a node page write completes, if the page belongs to the warm node list, its associated fsync node entry is deleted, preventing stale entries that could affect future fsync operations.

intent_record.intent_summary: Remove premature deletion of fsync node entry for warm node folios in write end I/O handler, preventing potential data loss during fsync.
intent_record.what: Removed conditional deletion of fsync node entry for folios in warm node list within f2fs_write_end_io.
intent_record.how: Previously, after a bio completes, if the folio was in the warm node list, its fsync node entry was deleted. Now that deletion no longer occurs in this path, potentially retaining fsync entries for warm node folios until a later point.

grouping_result.intent: Remove premature deletion of fsync node entry for warm node folios in write end I/O handler, preventing potential data loss during fsync.
